Regular cleaning after use extends the life of the stainless steel surfaces and frying tanks. Remove fryer baskets and clean to avoid oil residue buildup.

Check gas connection fittings routinely for safety and leak prevention. Kitchen And All supports customers with delivery across Kenya and can assist with guidance on installation and maintenance to keep your fryer operating efficiently.

faqs.a: The current price is shown on this page. Gas fryer prices depend on tank size and whether you need extra burners or a griddle on the same unit. Call or WhatsApp us for a quote for your exact needs, with free delivery within Nairobi.

faqs.q: Is this an electric or gas fryer?
faqs.a: This fryer uses gas burners for cooking as shown clearly in the photo; it is not electric despite the product name.

faqs.q: What is the capacity of each fryer tank?
faqs.a: Tank volume is not confirmed from the photo or product notes; please check with the supplier.
